question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
evidence: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave is requested in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance.

question: When do carried-over leave days expire?
evidence: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March.

question: After how many consecutive sick days is a doctor's note required?
evidence: Employees may take 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.

question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do secondary caregivers receive?
evidence: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks of paid parental leave.

question: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
evidence: Expense claims must be submitted in the finance tool within 30 days of the purchase, with an itemised receipt attached.

question: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
evidence: When travelling, meals are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed.

question: How many times per year can the missing-receipt form be used?
evidence: If a receipt is lost, complete the missing-receipt form and get approval from your line manager. This is allowed at most twice per year.

question: Which purchases need approval from a director?
evidence: Purchases above 1,000 dollars need written approval from a director before the money is spent.

question: What is the minimum password length?
evidence: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must never be shared, including with colleagues or IT staff.

question: Which app is used for multi-factor authentication?
evidence: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, the VPN and all cloud tools. Use the Northwind Authenticator app.

question: What extension is the security hotline?
evidence: Report suspicious emails with the Report Phish button in the mail client. If you clicked a link, call the security hotline on extension 4444 immediately.

question: Where should found USB drives be handed in?
evidence: Unknown USB drives must not be plugged into any company device. Hand found devices to the security desk on floor 2.

question: What time do new starters arrive on their first day?
evidence: New starters arrive at 9:30 on their first day and meet their onboarding buddy at the reception desk.

question: Where do new starters collect their laptop?
evidence: Your laptop is set up by IT before day one. Collect it from the IT bar on floor 3.

question: How long do new starters have to finish the security e-learning?
evidence: All new starters must finish the security and data-privacy e-learning modules within their first 14 days.

question: How long is the probation period?
evidence: The probation period lasts 6 months. A review meeting with your manager takes place at month 3 and month 6.

question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
evidence: Employees who have passed probation may work remotely up to 3 days per week, agreed with their manager.

question: How much is the home office allowance?
evidence: A one-off home office allowance of 400 dollars is paid for a desk, chair or monitor.

question: How many days per year can employees work from another country?
evidence: Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per year and needs HR approval in advance.

question: What are the core collaboration hours?
evidence: Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, when everyone should be reachable.

question: Which portal is used to book business travel?
evidence: All business travel is booked through the TravelDesk portal. Flights must be booked at least 14 days ahead where possible.

question: When is premium economy allowed?
evidence: Economy class is used for flights under 6 hours. Premium economy is allowed for flights of 6 hours or longer.

question: What is the hotel limit per night in high-cost cities?
evidence: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to 180 dollars per night in most cities and 250 dollars per night in high-cost cities.

question: Above what value must supplier gifts be declared?
evidence: Gifts from suppliers worth more than 50 dollars must be declined or declared to the compliance team.

question: Who must you tell about a conflict of interest?
evidence: Any personal relationship with a supplier or candidate must be disclosed to your manager and the compliance team.

question: How can concerns be raised anonymously?
evidence: Concerns can be raised anonymously through the SpeakUp line, which is run by an independent company.

question: Who is allowed to speak for Northwind publicly?
evidence: Do not share confidential company information on social media. Only the communications team speaks for Northwind publicly.

question: How often are laptops replaced?
evidence: Laptops are replaced every 4 years, or sooner if they fail and cannot be repaired.

question: Can you install software on a company laptop without approval?
evidence: Reasonable personal use of company laptops is allowed, but no software may be installed without IT approval.

question: How quickly must a lost device be reported?
evidence: Report a lost or stolen device to the IT service desk within 24 hours so it can be wiped remotely.

question: How much are leavers charged for an unreturned laptop?
evidence: Leavers must return all equipment on their last working day. Unreturned laptops are charged at 900 dollars.

question: How long are customer records kept?
evidence: Customer records are kept for 7 years after the end of the contract and then deleted.

question: Where should customer data requests be forwarded?
evidence: Requests from customers to see or delete their data must be forwarded to privacy@northwind.example within 2 working days.

question: How quickly must a suspected data breach be reported?
evidence: A suspected data breach must be reported to the privacy team within 1 hour of discovery.

question: In which months do performance reviews happen?
evidence: Performance reviews happen twice a year, in June and December.

question: How many points does the performance rating scale have?
evidence: Each review uses a 4-point scale: below expectations, meets, exceeds, and outstanding.

question: When do pay rises take effect?
evidence: Pay rises are decided in the December review and take effect from 1 February.

question: How large is the yearly learning budget?
evidence: Every employee has a learning budget of 1,200 dollars per year for courses, books and conferences.
